thread:
kai_ops: FYI OrionTech sent two pallets of H200s. 12 units received, 3 appear DOA on initial power check. Vendor suggests priority courier for the 3 and standard sea for the remainder. Need cost split and depot routing. @maria_procurement @jade_logistics

maria_procurement: Ask for serials and failure summary. Also get a line-item quote for courier and a breakdown (air vs handling vs insurance). Who pays duties if we expedite?

jade_logistics: If we air, route to AMS-depot-1 (closest RMA bench). They can do swap+burn-in within 24h. Depot requires manifest_v3 + pre-alert CSV. No crossdock.

leo_platform: Can we avoid spinning up temp Dedicated? 3 units out of 200 shouldn't hit capacity hard, but we need the exact models; H200-P vs H200-X differ on rails. If swapping, make sure brackets included.

kai_ops: Vendor note: failures = PSU/power-on. Serial list (redacted): H200-OT-77, H200-OT-78, H200-OT-79. Air quote = $9,750 + customs/fees. Vendor asks for 40% expedite share. They claim carrier surge is 30% of cost.

maria_procurement: 40% still high. Counter 20% if OrionTech covers customs/duties and provides carrier invoice. We should request timestamped photo evidence and a signed DOA form before paying expedite.

jade_logistics: Agreed on photos + DOA form. Also need commercial invoice with HS code. Ops uses HS 8542.31.00 for customs; vendor must confirm. Example pre-alert CSV header:

```
AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,OrionTech,AMS-depot-1,3,"H200-OT-77;H200-OT-78;H200-OT-79",85423100,swap
```

kai_ops: Uploaded temp labels: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/1768012345/labels.pdf (placeholder). Also requested vendor DOA photos.

leo_platform: If air goes through, I'll reserve 1 hot-spare from pool for 48h as buffer. Est cost $600/day. Approve?

maria_procurement: Approve reserve. I'll draft PO amendment with 20% expedite share and clause: "vendor covers customs/duties and provides carrier invoice and photos within 6h of ship." Send to them now.

jade_logistics: Action items:
1) kai_ops - confirm serials & upload vendor photos + DOA form by 14:00 CET.
2) maria_procurement - send PO amendment & request carrier invoice breakdown.
3) jade_logistics - book AMS-depot-1 slot conditional on AWB.
SLA target: 72h from AWB to swap complete. :white_check_mark:

reminder_bot: Follow-up reminder set for 6h if vendor has not uploaded photos or AWB.

kai_ops: Will chase OrionTech now. Tagging legal if vendor requests non-standard terms: @maria_procurement/legal-review.

maria_procurement: Noted. If vendor refuses to cover customs, escalate to finance. We'll avoid >25% expedite without receipts. :thumbsup:
